questions.prompt: The file ends with step/start for step 2 of turn 1, and no later events. Which closers does closersFor return?
options: Only turn/end, because the turn is what is open
step/end for step 2, then turn/end with reason interrupted
None, because the last event is a start event
questions.explanation: Both step 2 and turn 1 are open. The step closes first, then the turn, with reason interrupted to show a crash ended it.

questions.prompt: Why does resume append closers instead of deleting the events of the unfinished turn?
options: Deleting events would break the JSON on each line
The stored events are true facts, and the model must see the work done before the crash
The closers are smaller than the deleted events
The model refuses requests with fewer events
questions.explanation: An append-only log never removes facts. The turn may have changed files, so the model must still see the call and its result in its history.

questions.prompt: loadEvents meets a line that is not valid JSON in the middle of the file. What does it do, and why?
options: It skips the line, because crashes cut lines
It drops every line after it
It throws, because a crash can only cut the last line
It replaces the line with a closer
questions.explanation: Each flush adds whole lines at the end, so a crash can only cut the last line. A bad line in the middle means the file is damaged.
